translations./garage/brief: After RO-1 retrieves the power module, east-district traffic resumes. It must route around the shelf, stop and observe at the dynamic intersection, then cross the forklift corridor to activate the Lan Valley signal tower.
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: How far is the forklift from the intersection?
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Distance is one clue. Direction and speed reveal whether both paths will reach the intersection at the same time.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Where will the forklift move next?
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: With position and velocity, RO-1 can project the forklift forward and test whether their paths intersect. Watch when it begins to wait.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Put the forklift in the static map
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: The forklift moves. A static map represents fixed obstacles, not where a moving object will be next.
